verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence shows a Kimi project or space feature that groups related chats and files under shared context and instructions. The near-matches are adjacent, not this capability: a generic memory feature listing (kimi-docs-14), opening a local code folder in Kimi Code Desktop (kimi-docs-1), and Admin API 'projects', which organize API keys and billing rather than chats.

support.subject: As a knowledge-worker, I can organize related chats and files into a project or space that shares context and instructions
